decision.summary: Tenant Jonah Okafor (vulnerable) is locked out tonight after his key snapped in the front door lock. I opened emergency job JOB-101 linked to the stiff-lock report R-4766, texted the out-of-hours locksmith, emailed the tenant and landlord, and escalated P1 (ESC-106) so someone confirms the attendance tonight. The cost is not decided: lock fault is the landlord's, key misuse the tenant's, per the locksmith's report.

answers.question: 1. Tenant-responsibility lockout or landlord lock fault?
answers.answer: Not yet determined. Policy: a lost or misplaced key is the tenant's cost out of hours, a broken lock is the landlord's, and an unclear cause is decided by the locksmith report. Evidence points both ways: a snapped key suggests key damage or misuse, but the lock has been stiff since 22 Sept (R-4766), which points to a lock fault. Treat as unclear until the report is in.

answers.question: 2. Options for the tenant tonight and who pays
answers.answer: (a) Out-of-hours locksmith Hackney Locks 24/7 attends tonight: sent and awaiting confirmation. Cost follows the report: landlord if lock fault, tenant if key misuse. (b) Office spare key from the key safe: only Mon-Fri 9:00-17:30 with £50 refundable deposit, so not available tonight. (c) If the locksmith cannot attend, an alternative 24h locksmith, with the same report-based recharge, needs urgent confirmation by the maintenance team.

answers.question: 3. Actions taken
answers.answer: Opened JOB-101 (emergency, linked to R-4766). Texted the locksmith to attend and report (A2). Emailed the tenant with the plan, cost rule, key safe hours and safety/helpline advice (A3). Emailed the landlord, who has emergency approval in her notes (A4). Added note (A5). Escalated P1 to maintenance (A6, ESC-106).

args.body:
Hi Jonah,

Thanks for calling. We've logged this as an emergency and have sent a 24-hour locksmith, Hackney Locks 24/7, to 27 Bethnal Green Road. We are asking them to attend tonight and to confirm their arrival time to us. We will pass that on as soon as we have it.

On cost: the locksmith will write a report on what caused the lock to fail. If the lock itself is faulty, the landlord pays. If the key was damaged through misuse, you may be asked to pay. We will not decide that until we have the report, and we will tell you before anything is charged to you. Your earlier report about the stiff lock (R-4766) is on file and we are raising it with the landlord.

Our office is closed now, so the office key safe (for a spare key, £50 refundable deposit) is only collectable Monday to Friday 9:00 to 17:30.

While you wait, please keep yourself safe and warm. If you feel unwell or in danger, call 999. If you need someone to talk to, Samaritans is free on 116 123.

Reply to this email if anything changes.
